definition: Sends each gate message through the first Fast Chat call as production builds it (AgentCoreCoachProvider._invoke_payload: same composed runtime rules, history planner and Converse messages; the runtime system prompt from agentcore_runtime.structured_coach.specialist_system_prompt; the FastChatTurnOutput tool schema; the response checked by backend.agentcore_provider._validated_fast_chat) with the SOURCE CHECK rule on (request.source_need_check). Composition as in needs_sources_stubs: a message counts as retrieved when the gate searched a source, or when it is eligible for the second chance and the model's honoured needs_sources flag is true. The flag is honoured only on a Q&A turn. Rows whose call failed are not scored in 'overall' and 'by_category'; 'overall_failed_in_denominator' keeps them in two readings: failed_as_gate_only (a failed call raises no flag, the gate result stands) and failed_as_error (a failed retrieve row is a wrong skip, a failed skip row is a false retrieve). Eligible rows are the only rows whose flag changes a metric; the flag on other rows is reported as raw flag rate only. With FAST_CHAT_SOURCE_CHECK_TITLES_ENABLED on, the course material titles from the manifest are added to the rule (see source_check_titles).
